attach_file.description: Attaches one persistent file to the JIN context.
rules: DO NOT attach files if they are already present in user message with correct ids.
Emit one marker per file id to attach that saved file to context.
id is a placeholder; replace it with the 6-character id shown in <ATTACHED_FILES> or LIST_FILES.
At most 5 files may be attached at once. Loading a sixth file is rejected deterministically.
Text files are inserted as text context; image/document files are provided through the existing attachment pipeline.
